message.content: Bronwyn shared her experience with a full support setup in her interactions. In discussing strategies, she mentioned trying a setup that included Ophelia and Alfyn, stating, "I tend to go for a full support setup sometimes! Characters like Ophelia and Alfyn together can keep everyone alive while still dishing out good damage." This indicates that Bronwyn found this setup effective for keeping her party alive and sustaining damage during challenging encounters. However, she also noted that it can be risky, emphasizing, "It’s all about surviving those grueling battles!" Thus, Bronwyn has had success with a full support setup, particularly in managing the health and damage output of her party effectively.
